findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 1, Harm 3
Raise: Not done
Case: normal use - A coordinator configures grouped CI or enables Codex Fast in an existing repository.
The unmet Done-when is: Every coordinator-guide line that tells the coordinator to edit forge.toml in a settings fix says the fix's Done-when must name forge.toml, and the generated SKILL.md copies match.
The template still directs settings changes without that requirement at lines 49 and 2426–2429 (groups and test commands), 471–472 (runner correction), 2147–2157 (Claude models), 2193–2198 (codex_fast), 2436 (shard options), 2442 (the full test command), 2489 and 2504 (fast_test), and 2546–2547 (post-sign-off sample_data). Both generated copies contain the same instructions. If the coordinator starts such a fix without naming the file, src/forge/task.py:205–219 does not permit the settings edit, and src/forge/worker.py:467–473 restores uncommitted forge.toml changes, discarding the requested edit.
findings.title: Not done: Settings-fix instructions must name forge.toml in Done-when

why: The coordinator guide still tells the coordinator to edit forge.toml in a settings fix without naming forge.toml in that fix's Done-when (skill.md around the prototype sample_data step, the runner labels step and the fast_test step), so a builder that the queue runner starts can restore the file and discard the edit; split from FORGE-RUNNER-1/RUNNER by the owner.
